scope: Explicit native audit-metadata templates and strict reference descriptor/template adaptation for Nuclia search and generated answers.
implemented: Optional version-1 audit_metadata templates use explicit enabled/fields configuration and existing typed parameters, original query and server-selected context. No automatic file, credential or arbitrary runtime metadata is inferred.

Static field names and string templates are bounded. Empty rendered values are omitted; whole scalar values use JSON spelling. Malformed expressions, missing values, spoofed context, caller metadata overrides and the serialized 10 KiB provider limit fail before HTTP.

Strict reference conversion accepts audit fields without executing packages or environment expressions. Import review declares outbound metadata and stricter missing-field behavior; disabled field definitions survive configuration export and file/SQLite restart.
Legacy descriptor bindings with disabled empty audit metadata retain their previous native connector shape. Existing connections gain no outbound metadata automatically.

Both actual find and synchronous ask calls carry selected audit values. Provider rejection raises a sanitized failure without replay. Metadata is not automatically added to answer artifacts, citations or trace metadata.

Existing Studio connector edits already preserve versioned templates. Operators configure audit fields through existing catalog or configuration validate/plan/apply operations; no separate visual audit editor is introduced.

affected_regressions.scope: Nuclia, retrieval evidence, configuration import/export, enterprise connectors, shared access and file/SQLite restart.

actual_http.scope: Real framework transport against the existing local Postman stand-in; audit, context, descriptor and attachment consumers plus failure cases.

simulation.scope: Combined explicit HTTP suite, including diagnostic attempt counters and intentional failure cases. No live account.

authority.contract: AuditMetadataBase string dictionary and 10 KiB serialized JSON limit inherited by BaseSearchRequest.
authority.discovery: Orbit returned unrelated audit/template APIs; none was integrated. Existing primary-source-backed Nuclia mock was extended. Owner mock discovery remains unavailable while Postman is signed out.

migration: Optional additive template field; existing state records and credentials are not rewritten. File and SQLite configuration records retain enabled/disabled fields across restart. Legacy disabled-empty descriptor bindings retain their earlier native shape.
